## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Aug 27, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Tom W_, Aug 27, 2026, 1/5: "it got one star because it wasn't anything less... it constantly crashes.. utilizes more space and time than all my other apps combined, and is unfixable. a new Galaxy 9 watch and S26 Ultra phone didn't improve its performance."
            2. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
